Found a Polović family of Žabljak, Karlovac: Juraj (George) Polovic b.16 Mar 1885 Žabljak, d.6 Nov 1939 White City IL, buried Mt Olive; parents Josip Polovic (1853-1934) & Magdalena Grman; Josip's parents Janko Polovic & Barbara Biscan; siblings Marko (1876-1947), Ivan x2, Jana; wife Kata Valent, 10 children (Nicholas, Joseph, Mary Rita, Michael...). Managed by Curtis Gene Leonhardt. Link to Dora/Barbara Polovich NOT shown.

src: MyHeritage — historical-record and tree search 'Vid Spudic' and 'Janko Spudic b.1891 Croatia' (free results page only, first 20 each; 3.29M hits unfiltered, not walked)
note: Trees list Vid Spudić b.8 Jan 1828 Leskovac Barilovićki (Curlovic tree: d.'1869?', son Mijo Josip 'Michael'; FamilySearch Family Tree: parents Johannes 'Janko' Spudić c.1801 & Ana Pavletić, wife Jelena Aršulić, daughter Jana, many siblings). All unsourced tree data. Also 1913 Ellis Island line (22 Apr 1913, Janko Spudic b.~1889, Leskovac, father Janko Spudic at home, joined brother Marko Spudic). Other Leskovac Vids (b.1715, c.1763, c.1771, c.1777, c.1829 m. Ana Radinović, 1839-41) are earlier or later generations.

src: Find a Grave — name searches Spudic (353), Spudich (177), Spudick, Spudić, Polovich, Polović, no location filter; all result pages fetched, Macoupin/Karlovac entries read from list; opened John Spudic Sr. and Marko Spudic memorials
note: TRAP: adding the location filter (Macoupin County / Illinois) returned 'No matches' for Spudic and Spudich though dozens exist; use the unfiltered search. Mt Olive New Calvary: John Spudic Sr. 6 Nov 1891-25 Nov 1957 (memorial 45193164, spouse Anna C. Spudic 1904-1990; no parents listed) = likely Janko; Marko Spudic 1888-1930 (16885967, son William Thomas 1930-1993); Thomas Spudic 1866-1922; Catherine Slott Spudic 1876-1924. Benld Cemetery has ~40 Spudich incl. Stephen Spudich 1868-1937 (45744105), Anna Dobrinic Spudich 1888-1979. Mt Olive Polovich: George Polovich 1886-1939 (16885678), Catherine 'Katie' Polovich 1889-1966, Michael 1913-1988, John Joseph 1926-2002. Croatia: Spudić and Polović burials at Sveti Petar Mrežnički (Duga Resa) and Kamanje parish; none at Leskovac. No Find a Grave memorial lists parents for Janko or Marko.

src: Ancestry (ancestry.com.au, requester logged in) — Janko Spudic b.1891 ±5 (13 results) and Polovich b.1860 ±20 (19,459 results, first page only)
note: Janko: 13 hits - an Ancestry tree 'Spudic Family Tree' listing Janko / John Spudich b.1891 Yugoslavia (parents hidden), Ellis Island/Hamburg passenger lists, 1930/1940 censuses (likely other John Spudics), Find a Grave index; most field values were masked on the results page and no record was opened. Polovich: first page only; includes 'Illinois, U.S., Roman Catholic Diocese of Springfield Sacramental Records, 1853-1981' (hit: Nicholas Polovich). That collection covers Macoupin County parishes (Mt Olive) and is the best lead for Janko's c.1920-22 marriage and Anna's maiden name; not yet searched for Spudic. Earlier bot-check block was cleared by the requester logging in.

src: Ancestry — Illinois, U.S., Roman Catholic Diocese of Springfield Sacramental Records, 1853-1981 (collection 61682): name Spudic (similar spellings), then marriages 1921 ±4; opened Janko/John Spudich b.1891 tree entry
note: 314 hits for Spudic and similar spellings (Latin forms: Joannis, Stephani, Thomae, Nicholai, Michaelis Spudic; baptisms of children). Results page masks dates and places; opening a record (e.g. 427663 'Joannem Spadich', marriage) or the 'Spudic Family Tree' person page (tree 188790393, person 312451317497) goes to Ancestry's 'Join' paywall, so no detail was read. Marriage filter 1917-1925 returned 5 index hits: Joannem Spadich, Helen, Bertha, George and Dorothy Spudich. These are only names; none is confirmed as Janko or Anna. Needs a paid Ancestry subscription, or a library edition (Ancestry Library at a public library often includes it), to read. The Diocese of Springfield archives (and Mt Olive parish) hold the originals.

src: Macoupin County ILGenWeb — marriage index page and partial groom list (surnames A-Z)
note: Groom list spans c.1829-1898 only, so it cannot hold a c.1920-22 marriage; no Spudic-type surname. Other online indexes on the page (UIS/IRAD, state archives) stop at 1900/1905. A 1920s marriage is NOT in any free online county index found.

src: Macoupin County Clerk, Carlinville — certificate copies (information only; no request sent)
note: Genealogy copies of marriage certificates 1829-1963 cost $5.00 (certified $15.00). Macoupin County Courthouse, Carlinville IL 62626, 217-854-3214, Mon-Fri 8:30-4:30. Clerk's own online index covers records before 1916 only, so a c.1920-22 marriage needs a direct request.
